successors.name: Kingdom of Sweden
successors.text: Tavastia (Häme): the modern regions Tavastia Proper, Päijät-Häme and Pirkanmaa, round Lake Vanajavesi, the core area on the page; the page gives no boundary

ledger.x: 1042: first mention, 'when Vladimir of Novgorod attacked them', the first time Finland appears in Russian texts.
1249: Tavastian independence ends with the Swedish victory ('Swedish victory' in the infobox, Tavastia 'becoming part of Sweden').

wars.name: Second Swedish Crusade
wars.outcome: A Swedish victory under Birger Jarl; Tavastia became part of Sweden.

certainty.note: Tribal lands without a boundary on the page; Tavastia is drawn as three modern regions round Lake Vanajavesi.
